title: REACTOR — BPM System：三种时间，一套可以演奏的视觉工程
titleEn: REACTOR — BPM System: Three Times, One Performable Visual System
summary: 从 REACTOR 现场操作视频与摄影出发，把持续影像、BPM 同步层与人工 Piano Trigger 拆解为一套可照着搭建、测试并演奏的 Arena / Ableton SOP。
summaryEn: A field-based SOP for building and testing an Arena/Ableton workflow combining continuous imagery, clocked motion, and human interruption.
